name: 89502 · Reno, NV
findings: ZIP 89502 (Reno) has 219 nonprofit organizations. 105 of them (48%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 81 organizations.
Health care organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (26% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 89502 (Reno) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
